governance_decisions.reason: Consolidation of overlapping hotel reservation logic. StayEasy duplicate route deprecated and redirected to TravelSphere canonical gateway route to eliminate redundant maintenance.
governance_decisions.migrationNotes: HTTP 301 gateway rewrite rule deployed on /gateway/stayeasy-reserve -> /gateway/bookings.

governance_decisions.reason: Contractual SLA Exemption: Partner airline requires direct IATA NDC XML format compliance for real-time ticket issuance. Both endpoints maintained with automated schema compatibility contract.
governance_decisions.migrationNotes: SLA Agreement Ref #SLA-FLYFAST-2026. Bi-weekly schema drift verification scheduled.

test_results.testName: Same Name, Different Business Meaning (/bookings vs /flight-bookings)
test_results.details: Verified that vertical domains (Hotel vs Flight) are segregated even with shared route tokens.

test_results.testName: Different Names, Same Semantic Meaning (/travel-orders vs /reservation-management)
test_results.details: Verified that semantic concept matching catches semantic synonyms across disparate routes.

test_results.expectedResult: Safe calculation without exception, confidence reflects data density
test_results.details: Algorithm handled zero-field inputs safely without NaN or crash.

test_results.expectedResult: Reject corrupt payload safely without server crash

test_results.details: Parser error handling prevented unhandled process termination.
